gap_policy: No fills through missing/quarantined bars. Reset all indicator/strategy state at each continuous segment; first1000 warmup. Open trade at gap: retain full unresolved position and known entry fee, no invented exit; exclude entire trade from conditional closed-trade ledger, restore its entry fee for conditional continuation, roll back its curve exposure. Not an investable full-period return; any censoring flagged. Terminal period liquidation only on valid observed close. No parameter selection.
historical_benchmark: buyhold known endpoint PnL only; no stop-risk equivalence; full path drawdown unverified over gaps
comparisons: previous A/B/C/D ORIGINAL,I,II with same dataset, segments, costs and risk; all run afresh, labels OLD_* distinct
outputs: checkpoint summary percompleted strategy/period/scenario; complete journal gz and full daily curve checkpoints local outside git; small aggregate JSON committed; ledger SHA/version fingerprints; no raw prices archive commit
